it.it: Due biglietti per Roma Termini, per favore.
it.english: Two tickets to Rome Termini, please.
it.ipa:
[dˈuːe biʎˈetːɪ pˌɛr rˈɔːma tˈɛrminɪ
 pˌɛr favˈoːre]

it.it: Solo andata o andata e ritorno?
it.english: One-way or round-trip?
One-way.

it.it: A che ora parte il treno?
it.english: What time does the train leave?
At eleven fifteen

it.it: Sei fortunato, è un Frecciarossa diretto.
it.english: You're lucky, it's a direct Frecciarossa.
Do we have time for a coffee?
Yes, we have half an hour.

it.it: Quale binario per il treno per Roma Termini?
it.english: Which platform for the train to Rome Termini?
it.ipa: [kwˈaːle binˈario pˌɛr ˌil trˈɛːno pˌɛr rˈɔːma tˈɛrminɪ]

it.it: Il binario numero sette. Vedrai i cartelli.
it.english: Platform number seven. You'll see the signs.
it.ipa:
[ˌil binˈario nˈumero sˈɛtːe
 vedrˈaɪ ˌɪ kartˈɛllɪ]

it.english: Don't forget your bag!

it.it: L'ho già presa. E tu, hai i biglietti?
it.english: I've already got it. And you, do you have the tickets?
it.ipa:
[lˌo dʒˈa prˈeːza
 ˌe tˈu
 ˌaj ˌɪ biʎˈetːɪ]

it.english: Yes, in my pocket.
Are you ready for the adventure?
Yes, more than ever!
The train is arriving soon.

it.it: Saliamo in fretta, c'è molta gente.
it.english: Let's get on quickly, there are a lot of people.

it.it: Ecco i nostri posti. Vicino alla finestra!
it.english: Here are our seats. By the window!
it.ipa:
[ˈɛkːo ˌɪ nˌɔstrɪ pˈostɪ
 vitʃˈiːno ˌalla finˈɛstra]

it.it: Si parte per una nuova vita!
it.english: Off to a new life!

it.it: Una settimana dopo, Sophie e Lucas stanno davanti alla stazione Termini.
it.english: A week later, Sophie and Lucas are standing in front of Termini station.
it.ipa:
[ˌʊna sˌɛtːimˈaːna dˈoːpo
 sˈopje ˌe lˈuːkas stˈanno davˈantɪ ˌalla stˌatsiˈɔːne tˈɛrminɪ]

it.english: Their backpacks are ready.
Excitement mixes with nervousness.
They approach the ticket counter.
Lucas looks at his watch.
They find a cafe in the station.
Sophie takes a deep breath.
An announcement echoes in the station.

it.it: Trovano i loro posti nel vagone.
it.english: They find their seats in the carriage.

it.it: Sophie guarda Roma che si allontana.
it.english: Sophie watches Rome as it recedes.
